summary: Strong, production-ready implementation. Workflow follows best practices: pinned action versions (checkout@v4, setup-bun@v2), minimal permissions (contents: read), deterministic env vars (CI, FORCE_COLOR), appropriate triggers, proper job dependencies. Source code has excellent TypeScript practices: explicit types, interfaces (LicenseLookup, LicenseConfig), semantic error messages, proper async/await, semantic exit codes. CLI has robust arg parsing with validation. Each module has clear single responsibility. Minor issues: (1) workflow shell lacks explicit `set -euo pipefail` (lines 46–52, low impact given simplicity); (2) complex regex patterns in manifest.ts lines 26–29 (npm) and 39–47 (pip) lack detailed comments explaining capture groups; (3) file-path resolution in workflow (lines 46–52) is somewhat hardcoded and could be more flexible. No duplication detected, error handling is thorough throughout.
